title: Depth sweep extreme: DEPTH=14
description: Changed DEPTH from 8 to 14 (n_embd 512->896, dropped DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 128->64 to avoid OOM); all other hyperparameters unchanged.
reflection: val_bpb 1.067556, clearly worse than baseline 1.014027. Since compute-per-token scales roughly cubically with depth under fixed ASPECT_RATIO, DEPTH=14 (~5x baseline FLOPs/token) leaves far too few optimizer steps in the 5-minute budget to pay off, even though most other agents this round tried more modest increases (10-12). This brackets the sweep from the high end: the compute-optimal depth for this budget is well below 14, likely at or below 8-10. Combined with a3's DEPTH=6 result, the group should now have a decent picture of the depth-vs-steps tradeoff curve without needing further extreme points.
